lines: Jaate jaate woh mujhe achchhi nishaani de gaya
couplets.en: As he left, he gave me a fine keepsake.

lines: Us se main kuchh paa sakoon, aisi kahaan ummeed thi
couplets.en: How could I have hoped to receive anything from him?

lines: Sab hawaayen le gaya mere samandar ki koi
